questions.question: What did the elders of Israel come to do in chapter 20?
options: Inquire of the LORD, but he refused to be inquired of by them
Beg Ezekiel earnestly to lead them all back to their own land
Crown for themselves a new king to reign over the people in exile
Offer up many sacrifices for the great city that had fallen
questions.answer: Inquire of the LORD, but he refused to be inquired of by them

questions.question: What does Ezekiel 20 rehearse?
options: The exact and detailed boundaries of all the land to be restored to the tribes
Israel's long history of rebellion from Egypt onward, and God's mercy for his name's sake
The long detailed genealogy of all of the priestly families who served faithfully at the altar
The future glory and great splendor of the holy temple that was yet to be rebuilt
questions.answer: Israel's long history of rebellion from Egypt onward, and God's mercy for his name's sake
